mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of triggered periods despite UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances despite HOUST > 1.3 million, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, following a prior 3-month trend of contraction, signals a weakening in real economic output and rising recession risk, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption (GDPC1) and residential investment (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and stagnant or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 5.0%) signals policy inaction amid inflationary pressure, increasing real rate uncertainty and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS ≤ 5.0%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in the specified direction, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in real private domestic investment (RSAFS) below 690,000 million dollars, following a prior 3-month decline, signals weakening business confidence and reduced capital spending, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 690000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
